targeted_primary_source_reviews.title: RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory
targeted_primary_source_reviews.scope: Abstract, methods section 3.3, experimental comparisons and stated limitations inspected.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.verified_method: Compares two memory-construction orders while fixing source content, timestamps, policy and answer model; tests support present, absent, restored, and matched nonsupport replacement. Source count and prompt length are matched. PersonaMem and LongMemEval-S experiments distinguish lost evidence from answer-stage variation.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.limitation: The focal compactor is controlled; PersonaMem histories have 4-7 records and LongMemEval restoration addresses single-record support loss. Reported effects were not reproduced here.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.prospective_implication: Memory order sensitivity, evidence tracing, and support-restoration controls are occupied prior art. PersonaSLM should not claim these alone as algorithmic novelty; any future history-selection intervention should use matched evidence and style-fidelity outcomes.

targeted_primary_source_reviews.title: Learning to Retrieve Missing Evidence for Long-Term Memory QA
targeted_primary_source_reviews.scope: Methods sections 3.1-3.5, experimental setup and results tables inspected.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.verified_method: MERA uses a globally searchable atomic-fact index and a separate verifier-gated per-question evidence graph; a 0.6B planner receives GRPO reward for newly recovered gold evidence. Comparison backbones include Qwen3-30B-A3B and GPT-4o-mini for evidence processing and answering.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.limitation: Answer accuracy uses an LLM judge; stated model-token cost excludes embeddings and vector retrieval. A small planner does not make the complete system a CPU-small-model baseline. No local reproduction.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.prospective_implication: Adaptive retrieval guided by verified evidence and missing-information state is occupied. Evaluate complete inference cost and persona fidelity before choosing a CPU-feasible adaptation.

targeted_primary_source_reviews.title: Stress Testing Factual Consistency Metrics for Long-Document Summarization
targeted_primary_source_reviews.scope: Official bibliographic page and paper methods, results and limitations inspected.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.verified_method: Six factuality metrics are stressed with seven intended meaning-preserving perturbations over SQuALITY, LexAbSumm and ScholarQABench. Retrieval-window and claim-density analyses expose surface-sensitive scoring.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.limitation: GPT-4o generates perturbations; the authors explicitly lack human verification that every perturbation preserves meaning and lack human factuality judgments for metric validation. Findings do not validate PersonaSLM semantic scoring.
targeted_primary_source_reviews.prospective_implication: Supports maintaining human semantic judgments and surface-robustness controls. It does not establish a dialogue-specific causal mechanism. Preprint linkage was not established; the DOI and ACL identifiers represent one work.
